title.zh: 符号表示与梯度检查框架

en.a: Fix the Jacobian and reverse-mode conventions used to track information and gradients through every later sequence architecture.
en.b: Fix the scalar-loss convention that lets every later conditional-model derivation be checked numerically.

zh.a: 修正雅可比矩阵和反向模式约定，用于追踪后续所有序列架构中的信息和梯度。
zh.b: 修正标量损失约定，使后续所有条件模型推导均可进行数值验证。
